g.text: Title: DUAL BASYS3 SENSOR SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE

g.desc: Title: DUAL BASYS3 SENSOR SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE

g.text: Basys3 Master <-> SPI Mode 0 / 1 MHz <-> Basys3 Slave with DHT11 and HC-SR04

g.desc: Basys3 Master <-> SPI Mode 0 / 1 MHz <-> Basys3 Slave with DHT11 and HC-SR04

g.text: HARDWARE ARCHITECTURE | Slave pins verified from Basys3-Master_orginal.xdc | 2026-11-04

g.desc: HARDWARE ARCHITECTURE | Slave pins verified from Basys3-Master_orginal.xdc | 2026-11-04

g.text: Master SPI package pins must be assigned and verified in the Master project's XDC.

g.desc: Master SPI package pins must be assigned and verified in the Master project's XDC.

g.text: Project-dependent; no Master XDC in this repo

g.desc: Project-dependent; no Master XDC in this repo

g.text: COMMON GND: MASTER + SLAVE + DHT11 + HC-SR04

g.desc: COMMON GND: MASTER + SLAVE + DHT11 + HC-SR04

g.text: Power each Basys3 from its own USB supply; connect board GNDs.

g.desc: Power each Basys3 from its own USB supply; connect board GNDs.

g.text: Do not connect HC-SR04 5 V ECHO directly to an FPGA pin.

g.desc: Do not connect HC-SR04 5 V ECHO directly to an FPGA pin.

g.text: Keep SPI wiring short. Connect only GND and 3.3 V logic signals between boards.

g.desc: Keep SPI wiring short. Connect only GND and 3.3 V logic signals between boards.

g.text: JC1 K17 SCK | JC2 M18 CS_n

g.desc: JC1 K17 SCK | JC2 M18 CS_n

g.text: JC3 N17 MOSI | JC4 P18 MISO

g.desc: JC3 N17 MOSI | JC4 P18 MISO

g.text: MISO: response byte / Hi-Z when CS_n=1

g.desc: MISO: response byte / Hi-Z when CS_n=1
